inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Inner-membrane map (as printed on p. 76): NADH/NAD+ and FADH2/FAD labels at complexes I and II, CoQ between II and III, cytochrome c below the band between III and IV, 1/2 O2 + 2H+ → H2O at IV, ADP + Pi → ATP at V, H+ arrows at I/III/IV (down into the intermembrane space) and up into V, Cyanide/CO inhibit tag at IV, and the Uncoupling proteins / Aspirin overdose leak channel at the left. NOTE (source verification): the approved inventory's description mentioned rotenone/amytal, antimycin, and oligomycin — those names appear nowhere in the 2026 text layer (both book parts searched) and are absent from the printed figure; the redraw follows the actual page.

notes: The p76 figure is the topic's single textbook visual; redrawn in full label fidelity (complexes, both carriers, substrate/product labels, four H+ flows, uncoupler channel, cyanide/CO tag). Source-verification correction documented in sourceFigureDescription: the classic inhibitor names (rotenone/amytal/antimycin/oligomycin) are NOT printed in FA 2026 and were not added.
